steps.what: Take or receive periodic inmate counts and reconcile discrepancies before accepting the count

tasks.design: Keep physical counting, receipt and reconciliation with officers and the supervisor. Existing movement records in {OPS_SYSTEM} support the check; a matching total does not prove every person is present.
tasks.previous_blocker: A count requires reliable identification and resolution of movements and conflicting observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Record tools support reconciliation but do not establish unattended physical verification.
tasks.still_hard: Transfers and simultaneous movements can leave apparently consistent but wrong counts.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor challenges conflicting observations and orders a recount.
tasks.altitude: Count accountability and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain count discrepancies for a supervised recount

evidence.claim: Retaining physical count verification is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; the digest supplies no automated inmate-count validation case.

assumptions: Boundary is the supervisor's count or receipt and reconciliation, excluding officers' separately performed counts and movement-record maintenance.
Officers produce their count reports and authorised movement staff maintain existing movement records; no new structured present flag is assumed or automated.
Use existing records; no custom tool proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the workflow does not change.
unknowns: Local counting procedure and movement controls
research_questions: Which discrepancy types require physical recount rather than record reconciliation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; physical verification and discrepancy resolution retain their full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study institutional policies, rules, procedures and regulations relevant to current duties
Comply with and enforce institutional requirements in actual custody situations

tasks.design: Retain study of the approved rules in {DOCS} and contextual enforcement by the supervisor. Search can support navigation, but this task supplies no separate repetitive lookup baseline to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Knowing a rule and applying it fairly require interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access helps consultation without replacing understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Rules may conflict or need clarification in urgent custody situations.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor balances lawful requirements, welfare and the immediate circumstances.
tasks.altitude: No decision rights or capacity change claimed.

reach.task: Raise ambiguous institutional requirements for clarification

evidence.claim: Keeping policy learning and enforcement human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is learning and applying policy; separate operational supervision and individual searches must not duplicate the same action in roll-up.
Policy owners supply current approved texts through existing publication duties; no structured lawful-action flag is presumed.
Retain native document access; no new answer system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no change is introduced; national rules need local confirmation.
unknowns: Applicable national custody rules and policy ownership
research_questions: Which recurring ambiguities need authoritative policy clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; reading for understanding and contextual enforcement keep full time.

tasks.short: Direct correctional officers in safe custody

steps.what: Supervise correctional officers and direct custody, discipline and inmate welfare responses

tasks.design: Keep operational direction and welfare judgement with the supervisor. Approved guidance in {DOCS} informs decisions; no generated risk score or automatic disciplinary direction is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Safe custody depends on context, staff behaviour and inmate welfare.
tasks.enabler_now: Administrative tools do not replace real-time command responsibility.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently routine event can escalate or conceal a welfare concern.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor reads the situation and intervenes proportionately.
tasks.altitude: Operational accountability and time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Describe an immediate inmate welfare concern for specialist attention

evidence.claim: Retaining frontline custody command is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is active supervisory direction, excluding roster preparation, separately counted searches and officers' execution labour.
No free structured welfare or discipline score is assumed.
Existing guidance remains; no custom command tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process changes; roll-up assigns overlapping policy enforcement once.
research_questions: Where does routine officer discretion require supervisor intervention?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; direct supervision and welfare judgement remain fully counted.

steps.what: Supervise or perform authorised searches of inmates or quarters for contraband items

tasks.design: Retain authorised physical searches and supervision of search practice. References in {DOCS} support lawful methods; no automated contraband classification is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searches involve physical access, concealed items and personal dignity.
tasks.enabler_now: Record software does not perform the physical examination or supervise proportionate conduct.
tasks.still_hard: An object's significance depends on context and permitted possessions.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor detects unsafe or inappropriate methods and resolves uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Search responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Describe suspected contraband for correct evidence handling

evidence.claim: Keeping physical searches human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor search performance or supervision, not officers' separate labour or later evidence paperwork.
The responsible custody authority supplies existing search authorisation before this task; no automatic suspicion or permitted-item flag is assumed.
Use current procedures; no custom detection system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; confirm national search requirements locally.
unknowns: Search powers, authorisation procedure and permitted possessions
research_questions: Which uncertain finds require specialist evidence assessment?
